chapter_keywords: a record of a mortals journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 503: The Ghost's Final Pitch, Han Li's Refusal
chapter_meta_description: The Profound Bone Saint offers everything to save his soul, but Han Li knows a dead ghost is a trustworthy ghost. Plus, an ancient map reveals a secret escape route!
og_description: Han Li refuses a dangerous deal and finds a new path on an ancient map.
twitter_title: The Art of the Refusal: Han Li vs. a Thousand-Year Ghost
twitter_description: A quiet victory: Han Li chooses death over debt and gains a map to a secret teleportation array.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare spirit beast known for its ability to suppress and devour evil spirits and demon souls; its nose emits a 'Soul-Devouring Light' that can drag out the soul from a possessed treasure or body.
The signature technique of Extreme Yin Island; as revealed here, its founder, the Profound Bone Saint, never taught the complete version to his disciple, Extreme Yin.
A demon or ghost bound to serve a master through a soul pact; considered extremely risky in the cultivation world as a cunning ghost will always seek to reverse the power dynamic.
A ritual artifact used to control and command the Crying Soul Beast; Han Li uses it to call and dismiss the beast at will.

A concealed spiritual marker placed on a target by a higher-realm cultivator, allowing them to be tracked over vast distances; the novel’s system is clear: you cannot erase a mark you cannot even sense.
A rare and powerful breed of spirit insect that devours metal and spiritual energy; Han Li uses their unique sensitivity to locate the invisible tracking mark on his body.
The floating jade palace in the sky, a central dungeon of this arc; it contains sealed treasures and ancient secrets.
The supreme treasure sealed in the innermost chamber of the Void Heaven Palace; the primary objective of the expedition.
